passive.name: Mind Game
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases the wearer's Skill DMG and Ultimate DMG dealt by **60/70/80/90/100%**, lasting for **3** turn(s). After the wearer uses their Ultimate, if this Ultimate consumed **140** or more Energy, recovers 1 Skill Point.

passive.name: A Knight's Pilgrimage
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **36/42/48/54/60%**. When the wearer uses Ultimate, increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Ultimate based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG dealt by Ultimate by **0.36/0.42/0.48/0.54/0.6%**. A max of **180** points of Energy will be taken into account for this.

passive.name: A Storm Is Coming
passive.text: After entering battle, increases the wearer's DMG based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG by **0.2/0.25/0.3/0.35/0.4%**. A max of **160** Energy will be taken into account for this.

passive.name: Meteor Swarm
passive.text: For every enemy on the field, increases the wearer's ATK by **9/10.5/12/13.5/15%**, up to 5 stacks. When an enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, the DMG dealt by the wearer increases by **30/35/40/45/50%** for 1 turn.

passive.name: Boundless Thought
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **8/9/10/11/12%**. After using an attack, for each enemy target hit, additionally increases ATK by **4/5/6/7/8%**. This effect can stack up to 5 times and last until the next attack. If there are **3** or more enemy targets hit, this unit's SPD increases by **8/10/12/14/16%**, lasting for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Each Now Has a Role to Play
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by **24/30/36/42/48%** for **3** turn(s).

substatLine: SPD (Breakpoint) > CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK%

entries.name: Fleeting Fragrance
entries.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to **100%** of Argenti's ATK to one designated enemy target.

entries.name: Justice, Hereby Blooms
entries.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to **120%** of Argenti's ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: For In This Garden, Supreme Beauty Bestows
entries.text: Consumes **90** Energy and deals Physical DMG equal to **160%** of Argenti's ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: Merit Bestowed in "My" Garden
entries.text: Consumes **180** Energy and deals Physical DMG equal to **280%** of Argenti's ATK to all enemies. And further deals DMG for **6** extra time(s), with each time dealing Physical DMG equal to **95%** of Argenti's ATK to a random enemy.

entries.name: Sublime Object
entries.text: For every enemy hit when Argenti uses his Basic Attack, Skill, or Ultimate, regenerates Argenti's Energy by **3**, and grants him a stack of Apotheosis, increasing his CRIT Rate by **2.5%**. This effect can stack up to **10** time(s).

entries.name: Manifesto of Purest Virtue
entries.text:
After using the Technique, enemies in a set area are inflicted with Daze for **10** second(s). Dazed enemies will not actively attack the team.
When attacking a Dazed enemy to enter combat, deals Physical DMG to all enemies equal to **80%** of Argenti's ATK and regenerates his Energy by **15**.

entries.name: Piety
entries.text: At the start of a turn, immediately gains **1** stack(s) of Apotheosis.

entries.name: Generosity
entries.text: When enemy targets enter combat, immediately regenerates **2** Energy for self.

entries.name: Courage
entries.text: Deals **15%** more DMG to enemies whose HP percentage is **50%** or less.

entries.name: A Lacuna in Kingdom of Aesthetics
entries.text: Each stack of Apotheosis additionally increases CRIT DMG by 4%.

entries.name: Agate's Humility
entries.text: If the number of enemies on the field equals to 3 or more when the Ultimate is used, ATK increases by 40% for 1 turn(s).

entries.name: Thorny Road's Glory
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Trumpet's Dedication
entries.text: At the start of battle, gains 2 stack(s) of Apotheosis and increases the maximum stack limit of the Talent's effect by 2.

entries.name: Snow, From Somewhere in Cosmos
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: "Your" Resplendence
entries.text: When using Ultimate, ignores 30% of enemy targets' DEF.
